cards.name: Thunder Dragon
cards.officialText: You can discard this card; add up to 2 "Thunder Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.
behavior: Activation is restricted to the active physical player's open Main Phase and private hand.
Discard is paid immediately as cost and remains paid if the effect is negated.
At resolution, add zero, one, or two matching copies from that same physical player's private Deck.
Selection is non-targeting and revalidated at resolution; each physical copy can activate independently.

cards.name: Electric Snake
cards.officialText: When this card is discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, draw 2 cards from your Deck.
behavior: Trigger requires a real hand-to-shared-GY discard by an opponent-controlled card effect; costs and rule discards do not qualify.
The discarded copy must belong to the active physical representative whose private hand was affected.
Both cards are drawn from that physical owner's private Deck into that same private hand.
If fewer than two cards remain, the classic draw contract performs no partial draw and the owner team loses by deck-out.
A negated trigger draws nothing; the hand limit remains an End Phase check.

rules.physicalOwnership: UID m0–m3 remains attached to its original seat; shared Graveyard is team-scoped; hands and Decks remain private
